falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score drops below 30 within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant decrease in blowoff score indicates loss of momentum, invalidating the HOLD signal by showing no extreme market movement

falsification_conditions.condition: The ETF's price closes above $350 (20% above its 2024 Mar ETF price)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained price increase beyond this threshold would contradict the pattern match and suggest a bullish trend, disproving the UNKNOWN verdict

falsification_conditions.condition: The VIX index spikes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sharp rise in volatility would indicate market panic or extreme uncertainty, directly contradicting the HOLD signal's implication of stability

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
